# Directory Creation
```{r}
home_dir <- "/home/rstudio/DPSC_iN/multi_omic_analysis"

# Creating a list to hold some of the directory paths we re-use throughout
dir_list <- list()
dir_list$home <- home_dir
dir_list$data <- paste(dir_list$home, "data", sep = "/")
dir_list$scripts <- paste(dir_list$home, "src/R", sep = "/")
dir_list$plots <- paste(dir_list$home, "plots", sep = "/")
dir_list$docs <- paste(dir_list$home, "docs", sep = "/")
dir_list$rds <- paste(dir_list$home, "rds", sep = "/")

lapply(dir_list, dir.create, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(dir_list, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "dir_list.rds", sep = "/"), compress = FALSE)
gc()
```

# Importing metadata
```{r}
metadata <- fread(paste(dir_list$data, "sample_metadata_v5.csv", sep = "/"), data.table = FALSE)

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("DPSC", "iN")),
         donor_id = factor(donor_id, levels = c("D12", "D14", "D16", "D19")),
         sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = c("D12_DPSC", "D14_DPSC", "D16_DPSC", "D19_DPSC", "D12_iN", "D14_iN", "D16_iN", "D19_iN")),
         sample_id_new = factor(sample_id_new, levels = c("DPSC1", "DPSC2", "DPSC3", "DPSC4", "DPSC-iN1", "DPSC-iN2", "DPSC-iN3", "DPSC-iN4")))

# Creating a sample name map to replace the sample_names with the shorter sample_ids
sample_name_map <- setNames(metadata$sample_id, metadata$sample_name)

saveRDS(metadata, paste(dir_list$rds, "metadata.rds", sep = "/"))
```

# BioMart object - This goes to a script called biomart_lookup.R
```{r}
### Generating a biomart lookup table and functions to fetch gene ids ###

#
# Generating a biomart table
#

# Connecting to Ensembl to fetch the data. If connection fails, the data will be loaded from the previously saved rds file.
tryCatch({
  
  message("Connecting to Ensembl v113 ...")
  
  biomart_obj <- biomaRt::useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = 113)
  
  # Exporting two mapping tables since the getBM function limits the number of external columns that can be queried at once
  
  message("Retreiving tables ...")
  biomart_mapping_uniprot_1 <- biomaRt::getBM(attributes = c("uniprot_gn_id", "hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "entrezgene_id"), mart = biomart_obj)
  
  biomart_mapping_uniprot_2 <- biomaRt::getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "uniprotswissprot", "uniprotsptrembl"), mart = biomart_obj)
  
  # Merging the tables by ensembl ids
  biomart_mapping_ensembl_113 <- merge(biomart_mapping_uniprot_1, biomart_mapping_uniprot_2, by = "ensembl_gene_id", all = TRUE)
  message("Tables successfully retreived.")
  
  # Converting into a data table for faster operations
  setDT(biomart_mapping_ensembl_113)
  
  # Converting into long format for lookup
  biomart_mapping_ensembl_113 <- melt(biomart_mapping_ensembl_113, id.vars = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "entrezgene_id"), measure.vars = c("uniprot_gn_id", "uniprotswissprot", "uniprotsptrembl"), value.name = "accession", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Removing rows with NA accession IDs
  biomart_mapping_ensembl_113 <- biomart_mapping_ensembl_113[!is.na(accession), .(ensembl_gene_id, hgnc_symbol, entrezgene_id, accession)] 
  
  # Setting keys for faster lookup
  setkey(biomart_mapping_ensembl_113, ensembl_gene_id, entrezgene_id, hgnc_symbol, accession)
  
  biomart_rds_path <- paste(dir_list$rds, "biomart_mapping_ensembl_113.rds", sep = "/")
  saveRDS(biomart_mapping_ensembl_113, biomart_rds_path)
  
  rm(biomart_mapping_uniprot_1, biomart_mapping_uniprot_2, biomart_rds_path)
  gc()
  
}, error = function(e) {
  
  # On failure, loading the rds file
  message("Failed to connect to Ensembl. Using pre-saved biomart object ...")
  
  if (file.exists(biomart_rds_path)) {
    biomart_mapping_ensembl_113 <- readRDS(biomart_rds_path)
    message("Loaded biomart mapping from: ", biomart_rds_path)
  } else {
    stop("No connection to Ensembl and no saved biomart mapping found.")
  }
})

#
# Functions to fetch gene ids
#

get_ensembl_from_accn <- function(accn_id) {
  id <- biomart_mapping_ensembl_113[accession %in% accn_id, unique(ensembl_gene_id)]
  id <- id[!is.na(id) & id != ""]
  
  if (length(id) == 0) {return(NULL)}
  
  return(id)
}

get_accn_from_symbol <- function(gene_name) {
  id <- biomart_mapping_ensembl_113[hgnc_symbol %in% gene_name, unique(accession)]
  id <- id[!is.na(id) & id != ""]
  
  if (length(id) == 0) {return(NULL)}
  
  return(id)
}

get_entrez_from_ensembl <- function(gene_id) {
  id <- biomart_mapping_ensembl_113[ensembl_gene_id %in% gene_id, unique(entrezgene_id)]
  id <- id[!is.na(id) & id != ""]
  
  if (length(id) == 0) {return(NULL)}
  
  return(id)
}
```
